the performance of users in a task-based data collection system is dependent on the sensory and cognitive stages of data processing.

the performance of the users in the system can be measured by the time it takes them to complete tasks, and that the performance of users can be improved by making the interface more intuitive.

the cognitive processes are the most important ones to take into consideration when designing an interface for data collection.
the sensory stage in human information processing is a critical component of data collection systems and that its performance is dependent on the design of the interface.
